note: A CONTROL POPULATION, NOT FLEET (docs/design/FLOOR.md § 14 item 33(2), the seat's ruling of 2026-10-06, option (b)). These keys are the sample roster the card#11046 prototype searched the species salt `species:s1` over; most of them have no fleet record and nothing on the floor is drawn for them. AT-D3-24's salt leg uses them ONLY for its discrimination half: over this sample the unsalted draw repeats a body in some room, so the leg is known able to tell a salted draw from an unsalted one. The guarantee half — every room of the fleet draws distinct bodies — reads `roster.json`, never this file.
